```plato

    //==
    // # Array replacement
    //
    // The one primitive the fold needs that the array surface does not offer: an
    // array with one element changed. It belongs beside `Append` and `Concatenate`
    // in the foundation tier rather than here, and is written here because this
    // tier may not reach into that one.

    // `xs` with the element at `index` replaced by `value`; `xs` unchanged when the
    // index is out of range. Rebuilds the array, so a fold that replaces one
    // element per step is quadratic in the array's length.
    ReplacedAt(xs: Array<$T>, index: Integer, value: $T): Array<$T>
        => MapRange(xs.Count, i => i == index ? value : xs[i]);
```
